## 0. Summary

- 99 manifest entries: abstract 1, boss 12, elite 12, event 8, mock 8, normal 41, unlisted 2, weak 15.
- 4 acts in 3 slots: index 0 = Overgrowth (default) or Underdocks (needs UnderdocksEpoch), index 1 = Hive, index 2 = Glory; DeprecatedAct has index −1. 80 encounters sit in act pools; TunnelerNormal is registered but in no act.
- Tier over non-mock encounters (max effective tier of everything they spawn, plus encounter-level features): T1 = 37, T2 = 33, T3 = 21, T4 = 0.
- Port batches: B0 = 8, B1 = 50, B2 = 8, B3 = 6, B4 = 6, B5 = 5, B6 = 6, B7 = 1, B9 = 9 (rule: max batch of the spawned monsters).
- 14 encounters draw from the encounter-private Rng (composition or starter moves); 19 declare `Slots`; 5 event encounters are listed in `ModelDb.EventEncounters` (`Models/ModelDb.cs:170`) and 3 more are entered by events directly.
- Version delta: BattlewornDummy split into 3 encounter classes (ids changed), Tags added to SlitheringStranglerNormal and SnappingJaxfruitNormal (affects room generation), encounter Rng seed formula changed (engine).

## 2. Selection rules

| Rule | Citation |
| --- | --- |
| pool filters: weak = RoomType.Monster && IsWeak; regular = RoomType.Monster && !IsWeak; elite = RoomType.Elite; boss = RoomType.Boss (all over GenerateAllEncounters order) | Models/ActModel.cs:123-129 |
| rooms per act = BaseNumberOfRooms (-1 in multiplayer); floors = rooms + 2 | Models/ActModel.cs:185-198 |
| GenerateRooms(rng = RunRng.UpFront): events (act + shared, epoch-filtered) UnstableShuffle; normalEncounters = NumberOfWeakEncounters draws from a weak GrabBag, then draws from a regular GrabBag up to GetNumberOfRooms; eliteEncounters = 15 draws from an elite GrabBag; each bag refills (all weight 1.0) when empty; Boss = rng.NextItem(boss pool); Ancient = rng.NextItem(unlocked ancients ++ shared ancient subset) | Models/ActModel.cs:241-323; Runs/RunManager.cs:4077 |
| AddWithoutRepeatingTags: GrabAndRemove with predicate 'shares no EncounterTag with the previous list entry and is not that entry'; rejection sampling (one draw per attempt); unconstrained GrabAndRemove when no element qualifies | Models/ActModel.cs:362-373; Helpers/GrabBag.cs:34-82 |
| ApplyDiscoveryOrderModifications (Standard mode, TestMode off): Boss := first BossDiscoveryOrder entry the profile has not seen; then the act's own first-run hook (Overgrowth only, NumberOfRuns == 0) | Models/ActModel.cs:338-358; Runs/RunManager.cs:4078-4081, :4088-4108; Models.Acts/Overgrowth.cs:110-127 |
| A10 DoubleBoss: last act gets SecondBoss = UpFront.NextItem(boss pool minus Boss) | Runs/RunManager.cs:4082-4086 |
| map point counts (act GetMapPointTypes on the map Rng): rest-site count drawn first, then unknown-room count; NextGaussianInt(mean, stdDev, min, max) = Box-Muller on 2 NextDouble per attempt, Math.Round, retried until inside [min, max]; StandardRandomUnknownCount = NextGaussianInt(12, 1, 10, 14) | Random/Rng.cs:188-211; Map/MapPointTypeCounts.cs:57-60 |
| shared ancients: Darv subset handed to acts 2..n via UpFront.NextInt(count + 1) takes from an UnstableShuffle | Runs/RunManager.cs:4055-4072 |
| room pulls: NextNormalEncounter = normalEncounters[visited % count] (the first NumberOfWeakEncounters monster rooms therefore get weak encounters); NextEliteEncounter likewise; NextBossEncounter returns SecondBoss once a boss was visited | Rooms/RoomSet.cs:74-104 |
| act choice per index (StartRunLobby.BeginRunLocally): rng = Rng(GetDeterministicHashCode(seed) + GetDeterministicHashCode("act_selection")); for each ModelDb.ActsByIndex slot take the first unlocked non-default act not yet in Progress.DiscoveredActs (single player, TestMode off, profile-dependent), else rng.NextItem(unlocked acts of that slot); then act 0 := GetAct(lobby Act1), a no-op in v0.111.0 (the act dropdown is hidden, defaults to "random" and is copied into Act1 for single player and host; GetAct("random") is null); the same rng then resolves RandomCharacter picks | Models/ActModel.cs:470-505; Models/ModelDb.cs:244-275; Random/Rng.cs:42-45; Multiplayer.Game.Lobby/StartRunLobby.cs:236-242, :703-715, :737-748; Nodes.Screens.CharacterSelect/NCharacterSelectScreen.cs:1116, :1436-1439; Nodes.Screens.CharacterSelect/NActDropdown.cs:45-49 |
| encounter Rng seed (v0.111.0) = (ulong)((long)RunRng.Seed + (long)TotalFloor) + GetDeterministicHashCode(Id.Entry); v0.107.1 used (uint)((int)Seed + TotalFloor + old hash) | Models/EncounterModel.cs:202-216; v0.107.1 Models/EncounterModel.cs:259-270 |
| enemy order: after each AddCreature with a SlotName, List.Sort by Slots.IndexOf(SlotName) (introsort; insertion sort below 17 elements is stable, unknown slots compare as -1) | Combat/CombatState.cs:958-964; Combat/CombatManager.cs:6990-7005 |

Profile dependence (sim assumption: veteran profile, everything unlocked and seen): Underdocks unlock, act discovery forcing, boss discovery override, Overgrowth first-run order, ancient epochs (Neow, Orobas) and event epochs all read `UnlockState` or `SaveManager.Progress` (docs/sim-port/design-run-layer.md §5.6, §9.6).

## 4. Encounter Rng

`EncounterModel.Rng` is created once per encounter instance in `GenerateMonstersWithSlots` with seed `(ulong)((long)RunRng.Seed + (long)TotalFloor) + GetDeterministicHashCode(Id.Entry)` (`Models/EncounterModel.cs:202-216`); already ported (sim/specs/rng-encounter-private.md, `CombatRunContext`). Users and draw order:

| Encounter | Draws (in order) |
| --- | --- |
| BowlbugsNormal | NextItem x2: each worker drawn from {BowlbugEgg, BowlbugSilk, BowlbugNectar} (Dictionary insertion order) minus types already taken (each at most once) |
| BowlbugsWeak | NextItem: one of {BowlbugEgg, BowlbugNectar} |
| CorpseSlugsNormal | CorpseSlug.EnsureCorpseSlugsStartWithDifferentMoves(monsters, Rng): one NextInt(3), then StarterMoveIdx = (n + i) % 3 |
| CorpseSlugsWeak | CorpseSlug.EnsureCorpseSlugsStartWithDifferentMoves(monsters, Rng): one NextInt(3), then StarterMoveIdx = (n + i) % 3 |
| DecimillipedeElite | NextInt(3) = front StarterMoveIdx; middle (n+1)%3, back (n+2)%3 |
| FlyconidNormal | NextItem: one of {LeafSlimeM, TwigSlimeM} |
| PunchOffEventEncounter | NextInt(2, 10) StartingHpReduction for the first construct; NextInt(2, 10) for the second |
| RubyRaidersNormal | NextItem x3 without replacement over {AxeRubyRaider, AssassinRubyRaider, BruteRubyRaider, CrossbowRubyRaider, TrackerRubyRaider} (Dictionary insertion order, each at most once) |
| ScrollsOfBitingNormal | NextInt(3) = first StarterMoveIdx; second (n+1)%3, third (n+2)%3; fourth fixed 2 |
| ScrollsOfBitingWeak | NextInt(3) = first StarterMoveIdx; second (n+1)%3, third (n+2)%3 |
| SlimesNormal | NextBool: true -> (LeafSlimeS, TwigSlimeS), false -> (TwigSlimeS, LeafSlimeS) |
| SlimesWeak | NextItem small slime #1 from {LeafSlimeS, TwigSlimeS}; NextItem small slime #2 from the remaining one; NextItem medium slime from {LeafSlimeM, TwigSlimeM} |
| SlitheringStranglerNormal | NextItem over SecondaryEnemyType {SnappingJaxfruit, MediumSlime, SmallSlimes}; MediumSlime: NextItem {LeafSlimeM, TwigSlimeM}; SmallSlimes: NextItem {LeafSlimeS, TwigSlimeS} twice (with replacement) |
| TwoTailedRatsNormal | NextInt(3) = first StarterMoveIndex; second (n+1)%3, third (n+2)%3 |

Monsters never read `EncounterModel.Rng` after generation; in-combat randomness is `RunRng.MonsterAi`, `Niche`, `Shuffle`, `CombatCardGeneration` (inventory-monsters.md §6.3).

## 5. Slots and turn order

Monsters are created and added in `GenerateMonsters` order (`Rooms/CombatRoom.cs:381-394`); every add with a slot name re-sorts `_enemies` by `Slots.IndexOf(SlotName)` (`Combat/CombatState.cs:958-964`), so slot order is turn order. Encounters that name slots without overriding `Slots` (BowlbugsNormal first/middle/last, BowlbugsWeak odd/even, KnightsElite, SlumberingBeetleNormal first/second/third) compare every creature as −1 and keep spawn order (.NET `List.Sort` takes the swap-if-greater / insertion-sort path below 17 elements, which never moves equal keys); their slot names still feed `SlotName` reads (none of those monsters reads it). `SetEnemyIndex` throws for encounters with slots (`:966-980`).

Creation time differs by event layout (JSON `event_combat_rules`):

| Rule | Citation |
| --- | --- |
| events with LayoutType Combat (PunchOff, TheLanternKey, TheArchitect) build their CanonicalEncounter at event entry, after BeginEvent: GenerateMonstersWithSlots (encounter Rng), new CombatState, AddPlayer, then CreateCreature + AddCreature per monster (one RunRng.Niche HP draw each); entering combat later reuses that CombatState (ShouldCreateCombat false) | Rooms/EventRoom.cs:161-183; Multiplayer.Game/EventSynchronizer.cs:470-473; Multiplayer.Game/EventCombatSynchronizer.cs:83-128, :175-183 |
| other event combats (BattlewornDummy, DenseVegetation, FakeMerchant) create the CombatState only when EnterCombatWithoutExitingEvent fires (CreateCombatState(canonicalEncounter.ToMutable())) | Models/EventModel.cs:812-838; Multiplayer.Game/EventCombatSynchronizer.cs:175-178 |
| TheArchitect never calls EnterCombatWithoutExitingEvent: its Architect creature is display-only (animations only) | Models.Events/TheArchitect.cs:162, :322, :783-785, :1115 |

## 7. Rewards

Gold defaults by room type: Monster 10–20, Elite 35–45, Boss 100 (`Models/EncounterModel.cs:45-83`), ×0.75 then `(int)` at A3 Poverty (`Helpers/AscensionHelper.cs:12`). Overrides: FakeMerchantEventEncounter 300–300; `ShouldGiveRewards = false` for BattlewornDummyEventV1–V3 (and MockNoRewardsEncounter). Gold is scaled by `CalculateGoldProportion` (`Rooms/CombatRoom.cs:831`), default `1 − EscapedCreatures.Count / SpawnedEnemies.Count` (`Models/EncounterModel.cs:324-327`), where `SpawnedEnemies` holds distinct canonical monster models, not creatures (`OnCreatureSpawned`, `:343-360`, called from `Combat/CombatState.cs:722`). So an escaped ThievingHopper zeroes ThievingHopperWeak's gold. GremlinMercNormal overrides it: 1 unless the FatGremlin escaped, then 0 if gold was stolen (`Models.Encounters/GremlinMercNormal.cs:56-66`). Extra rewards raised in combat: HeistPower gold (FatGremlin killed), SwipePower card (ThievingHopper killed).

## 10. Open questions

1. Act choice is profile-dependent: an unlocked, undiscovered non-default act is forced into its slot (`Models/ActModel.cs:482-487`, `Progress.DiscoveredActs`) and Underdocks needs `UnderdocksEpoch`; the sim must take the act list (or these profile bits) as an explicit run parameter. Does the recorder capture the run's act list at run start? (The lobby `Act1` override is a no-op in v0.111.0: section 2.)
2. BattlewornDummy: the encounter ids changed between v0.107.1 and v0.111.0 (one id -> three); legacy-corpus replays must map them by the chosen setting.
